title: Mass bound M_U(Y) ≤ μ(F ∩ pL⁻¹(U)) for a current given by the pulled-back integral
statement: Let P, m, l ∈ ℕ, pL : ℝ^P → ℝ^m continuous linear, U ⊆ ℝ^m open, F ⊆ ℝ^P, μ a measure on ℝ^P, ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_l(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P l) and Y ∈ 𝒟_l(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U l). Write |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α and γ∘pL := γ.compContinuousLinearMap pL. Assume: for μ-a.e. x, |ξ(x)(β)| ≤ |β| for every l-covector β on ℝ^P; |γ∘pL| ≤ |γ| for every l-covector γ on ℝ^m; and Y(ω) = ∫_F ξ(x)(ω(pL x)∘pL) dμ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^l(U). Then M_U(Y) ≤ μ(F ∩ pL⁻¹(U)), where M_U(Y) = Y.massOn U is the supremum of ofReal(Y(ω)) over ω ∈ 𝒟^l(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ U and |ω(y)| ≤ 1 for all y.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m l : ℕ) (pL : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid m) (U : Set (Euclid m)) (F : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P l) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn U l), IsOpen U → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) l, |ξ x β| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∀ γ : Covector (Euclid m) l, covectorEuclideanNorm (γ.compContinuousLinearMap pL) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm γ) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U l, Y ω = ∫ x in F, ξ x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid m) l) (pL x)).compContinuousLinearMap pL) ∂μ) → Y.massOn U ≤ μ (F ∩ pL ⁻¹' U)
